EVERYTHING YOU NEED

Built for serious board repair

Every tool a technician needs, in one file that runs in any browser.

⚡
LIVE USB MULTIMETER PRO
Connect your FS9721-compatible meter via USB for real-time measurements. Auto-capture readings, detect voltage rails (21+ Apple rails), identify shorts with diode database, and log with timestamps. Live sparkline shows last 200 readings.
AI FAULT DIAGNOSIS PRO
Describe the symptom. AI analyses your board, OBD data, and measurements — then tells you exactly what to probe next.
PDF SCHEMATIC VIEWER
Load your schematic PDF. Click any component ref to instantly jump to it on the board. Click any board component to jump to the schematic. Fully linked.
VOLTAGE MAP PRO
Every component colour-coded by voltage. 9 voltage buckets. Click any bucket to select all components on that rail. Powered by OpenBoardData.
DIODE MODE MAP PRO
Instantly see which nets are shorted, suspect, or open. The fastest way to spot problems on a new board — before you even touch your meter.
PDF ANNOTATIONS PRO
Draw freehand, arrows, rectangles, and text labels directly on schematics. Saved per page, survives zoom and page turns. Undo/redo supported.
PROBE MODE PRO
Record live voltage, diode, and resistance readings. Instantly compared to OBD reference. Pass/fail highlighted. Export as CSV or HTML report.
MYCELIUM TRACER
Click any component to trace its full network of passive bridges — resistors, ferrites, inductors. Visualise power rails flowing through filter networks.
CONTINUITY CHECKER PRO
Are these two points connected? Type two refs or click two pads. BoardScope finds direct connections and paths through passive bridges.
SHORT CIRCUIT FINDER PRO
Scan all OBD diode data for nets below a threshold. Sorts by severity: DEAD SHORT, LIKELY SHORT, SUSPECT. Click to activate the net constellation.
POWER TREE PRO
Full-screen view of every power rail on the board — voltages, components, how they connect through bridges. Perfect for unfamiliar boards.
REPAIR TEMPLATES PRO
Built-in step-by-step sequences for dead boards, no charging, no backlight, kernel panics. Net names are clickable — tap to activate on the board.

AI-POWERED DIAGNOSIS

Tell the AI your symptom.
Get a repair plan.

BoardScope's AI reads your board data — component positions, OBD measurements, your probe readings, and component notes — then gives you specific, actionable next steps.

Net names and component refs in the response are clickable — tap them to zoom straight to that component on the board.

Works with any AI provider — Anthropic, OpenRouter, OpenAI, or even local Ollama models running on your machine.

🤖 AI DIAGNOSIS
Board is dead. No PPBUS. PP3V42 is 0V. Charger connected but ACOK not asserting.
Most likely: ACOK path fault

Start at CD3215C (U3100 pin 12) — check VBUS input first. Should be 5V from charger.

Then probe ACOK_L at U7090 pin 4. If VBUS present but ACOK not asserting, suspect the CD3215 or its I2C lines.

Check PP3V3_G3H at TP9251 — this powers the charger IC logic. If missing, fault is upstream.
